name: El Frago (Spain)
description: Blue field with red dancetty stripes edged yellow along the upper and lower edges, charged with a yellow oval of the bars of Aragon between two yellow crowns.
history: Municipal flag of El Frago; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: dancetty stripe edged yellow along the upper edge
dancetty stripe edged yellow along the lower edge
oval of the bars of Aragon
